name: cortados-pulse
description: A pane beside the chat with what the CortadOS router is running (child tasks, routed conversations, host jobs) and its live resource pool: routes and S1 health, every subscription lane's % left (per Claude account, Codex, Cursor, ...), online devices and model fit, with a link to the browser dashboard.

providerUrl.title: Provider URL
providerUrl.description: CortadOS provider base URL (e.g. http://<provider-host>:8432 on the tailnet). Leave empty to use CORTADOS_PROVIDER_URL, then the URL file (CORTADOS_PROVIDER_URL_FILE or ~/.config/cortados/provider-url).

providerTokenFile.title: Provider token file
providerTokenFile.description: Path to a file holding CORTADOS_PROVIDER_TOKEN. Read fresh on every poll so the token is never stored in settings; never logged or shown. A leading ~ is expanded to $HOME.

providerToken.title: Provider token (inline override)
providerToken.description: Optional inline token. When set it overrides providerTokenFile. Prefer the file so the token is not kept in settings.
